Name: Rainy Vanilla Music
Author: witchtopia
Description:
[size=5]🌧️ [b]LET IT RAIN... AND LET THE MUSIC PLAY![/b] 🎵[/size]

Love Stardew Valley’s soundtrack, but hate when rainy days turn into hours of nothing but rain, frogs, and distant thunder?

[b]Rainy Vanilla Music[/b] keeps the weather ambience intact while allowing Stardew Valley’s own seasonal music to play during rainy and stormy days. ✨

[center]🌧️━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🌧️[/center]

[size=4]✨ [b]MOD FEATURES[/b] ✨[/size]

🎵 [b]Music on rainy and stormy days![/b]
Rain no longer means spending the entire day without Stardew Valley’s soundtrack.

🌱 [b]Vanilla music only![/b]
Rainy Vanilla Music uses music already included in Stardew Valley. No third-party tracks or replacement audio files are added.

🌧️ [b]Weather ambience stays intact![/b]
Rain, thunder, frogs, and the rest of Stardew Valley’s atmospheric weather sounds still play normally alongside the music.

🍂 [b]Seasonal music selection![/b]
Different vanilla tracks are used depending on the current season.

🪶 [b]Lightweight and simple![/b]
This is a Content Patcher mod with no external audio files included.

🎶 [b]Plays nicely with music-frequency mods![/b]
Designed to pair well with mods that make vanilla music play more frequently during normal weather.

[center]🌧️━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🌧️[/center]

[size=4]🍃 [b]SEASONAL MUSIC[/b] 🍃[/size]

Rainy Vanilla Music currently uses one outdoor vanilla track for each season:

🌷 [b]Spring[/b]
Spring (It’s a Big World Outside)

☀️ [b]Summer[/b]
Summer (Nature’s Crescendo)

🍄 [b]Fall[/b]
Fall (The Smell of Mushroom)

❄️ [b]Winter[/b]
Winter (Nocturne of Ice)

All music is pulled directly from Stardew Valley’s existing audio library. 🎵

[center]🌧️━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🌧️[/center]

[size=4]🐸 [b]WHY THIS MOD EXISTS[/b] 🐸[/size]

Vanilla Stardew Valley intentionally leaves plenty of room for environmental ambience, especially during rainy weather.

And honestly? Sometimes that’s lovely.

Other times, you’ve spent half the day farming to:

🌧️ rain

🐸 frog

🌧️ rain

⛈️ thunder

🌧️ rain

🐸 frog again

...and eventually you start thinking:

[b]“Can somebody please turn the music back on?”[/b]

So I did. 🎵✨

[center]🌧️━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🌧️[/center]

[size=4]🎥 [b]STREAMER FRIENDLY[/b] 🎥[/size]

Rainy Vanilla Music does [b]not[/b] include any third-party music. It simply tells Stardew Valley to play music already included with the game, so the mod introduces no additional copyrighted audio beyond the vanilla Stardew Valley soundtrack.

As always, automated copyright systems can occasionally produce mistaken Content ID claims, but this mod does not add or redistribute any external music files.

[center]🌧️━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🌧️[/center]

[size=4]📥 [b]HOW TO INSTALL[/b] 📥[/size]

You’ll need:

🌱 [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b]

🔧 [b]SMAPI[/b]

🧩 [b]Content Patcher[/b]

[b]🔊 Positional Audio[/b]

Once those are installed, extract [b]Rainy Vanilla Music[/b] into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder and launch the game through SMAPI.

Then wait for your next rainy day and enjoy the soundtrack without evicting the frogs. 🌧️🐸🎵

[center]🌧️━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🌧️[/center]

[size=4]🧩 [b]COMPATIBILITY NOTES[/b] 🧩[/size]

Rainy Vanilla Music changes Stardew Valley’s music behavior for the main valley location context during rainy and stormy weather.

It should generally work alongside visual mods, maps, NPC mods, dialogue expansions, gameplay overhauls, and other mods that don’t alter the same rainy-day music behavior.

Mods that also change music during rain or storms may override Rainy Vanilla Music or be overridden by it depending on how they’re loaded.

Compatibility patch requests are welcome! 💕

Manifest.Name: Rainy Vanilla Music
Manifest.Description: Adds rainy-day vanilla music with separately controlled custom rain ambience while preserving location-specific music.
